reason: The README describes a DSH Web UI plugin whose primary purpose is automatically recovering interrupted agent sessions by sending configurable follow-up messages, with monitoring, backoff, loop protection, controls, and notifications.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DSH Web UI 的自动恢复插件，可监控中断或失败的会话并按配置发送继续消息，同时提供退避、暂停、循环保护、统计和通知功能。
summaries.en: A DSH Web UI plugin that monitors interrupted or failed sessions and sends configurable follow-up messages with backoff, pause controls, loop protection, statistics, and notifications.

capabilities: Monitors DSH session event streams for interrupted or failed turns
Automatically sends configured follow-up messages to resume sessions
Applies error classification, cooldowns, backoff, pause controls, and loop guards
Can cancel loop-detected turns and restart them with configurable text
Displays configurable browser notifications and session controls
Provides a settings card and activity statistics
